positive_global_styles: bright melodic house for a premium jet ski lifestyle brand film, tasteful not cheesy
piano chords, plucky synth lead hook, four-on-the-floor kick, shimmering hi-hats, warm bass
sea breeze, summer water, freedom and joy

positive_local_styles: the main hook and a light groove start immediately on the first beat, already catchy, bright
groove locks in with bass, motif repeats, carefree and moving forward
fuller, extra percussion and claps, a second melodic layer answers the hook, energy steps up
peak drive, full drums and bass, hook played big, exciting and fast feeling, last bar builds up
the biggest and most euphoric chorus, wide and open, joyful freedom
short breakdown with hook alone for two bars, then one big final hit on a downbeat that rings out naturally
